'''Football Club Vushtrria''' is a [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Vushtrri]], [[Kosovo]]. The club was founded in 1922, and currently play their home games at the 7,000 seat capacity Ferki Aliu Stadium in the city of Vushtrri. Notable players to have played for the club include former [[Albania national football team|Albania internationals]] [[Armend Dallku]] and [[Ahmed Januzi]], and [[Kosovo national football team|Kosovo international]] [[Milot Rashica]]."}}
